recipe.visualDefinition: A digital illustration depicting a young man in urban streetwear lounging in the Oval Office. He sits with feet up on a wooden desk, smoking, while the window behind him shows a chaotic scene of explosions and fighter jets. The style uses thick outlines and high-contrast digital painting, blending political iconography with street culture.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition between the formal Oval Office setting and the subject's casual streetwear.
Contrast between the calm interior and the violent, explosive exterior scene.
Symmetry provided by the flanking flags and heavy curtains framing the central window.
coreInvariants: Stacks of currency on the foreground desk

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated horizontally across the mid-ground, occupying the center-left to center-right space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central window pane containing the largest explosion serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face/smoke, follows the line of his legs to the right, drops to the money on the desk, and moves up to the chaotic background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with symbolic objects and environmental details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and golds from the curtains and desk provide the base environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues from the subject's jeans and the flags provide a cool counterpoint.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant oranges and yellows from the explosions create high-energy focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background chaos contrasts with the more muted, shaded tones of the interior office.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between light smoke and dark clothing

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus is on material finish and spacing.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in front of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, secondary sans-serif for metadata placed directly above the main title.
graphicDevices: Smoke wisps as organic framing elements

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric, wide, and authoritative feel.
Captures the technical, bold, and expanded aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Illustrate a man in a black hoodie and blue jeans sitting in a red chair with his feet on a large wooden desk in the Oval Office. Behind him is a window showing orange explosions and fighter jets in a dark sky. Include an American flag and a blue presidential flag on either side. Place stacks of money on the desk.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a bold, wide-tracked, metallic silver sans-serif font across the top third of the image. Add a smaller line of text in a similar font directly above it.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the main title sufficiently wide?
Does the metallic texture on the letters catch the light correctly?
Is the text centered perfectly between the two flags?
Is the hierarchy clear between the main title and the sub-header?

adjustableVariables: Amount of money on the desk
Level of metallic sheen on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific logos on the hat or desk
Identifiable brand names on the money bands
Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Cluttered foreground that obscures the subject's pose

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the smoke from the cigarette has a semi-transparent, wispy quality.
Check that the window frame correctly divides the background explosions.
Verify the metallic bevel on the text looks three-dimensional.
Confirm the lighting on the subject matches the glow from the explosions.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Political Setting] + [Urban Streetwear Subject] + [External Chaos/Warzone] + [Wide-Tracked Metallic Sans-Serif Typography] to create a satirical power-dynamic visual.
